sentences.en: This is an close-up shot of the strawberry tree fruit.
sentences.zh: 这是一张草莓树果实的特写照片。

sentences.en: All right, Mr. DeMille, I'm ready for my close-up.
sentences.zh: 好了，先生德米勒，我准备好面对我的特写了。

sentences.en: Seen close-up, things have a way of showing their defects, their innate ugliness.
sentences.zh: 近距离看，事物往往会暴露其缺陷和内在的丑陋。

senses.zh: 影视特写镜头,〈美俚〉精密观察,小传

mnemonic: 合成词：close（近）+up（向）→近而看得清→特写
